SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs (listening and speaking) 3.1.1 Active listening and observing keenly, part of MY FAMILY Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Experi in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: What do you like about your family?

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

B. At home with your parent or guardian

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Respect: Patience as learners take turn in telling stories about family members.

● Unity: Cooperation as the learner role plays on different family members.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
